Ham & Egg Brekkie Roll

A warm wholemeal roll filled with a fried egg, leg ham, sautéed mushrooms, baby spinach, avocado, and a touch of tomato sauce. Hearty, savoury and full of goodness.

Note: Slice mushrooms and spray with oil. Toss in airfyer for 4-5 mins. (throw roll in airfryer on top of mushrooms for last 2mins). Meanwhile, fry egg in a bit of olive oil. Stack roll with ham, avo, spinach, mushrooms, egg, and tomato sauce. Done.

● Protein: 26g
● Carb: 38g
● Fat: 19g
● Energy: 1773kJ
Ingredients
  • 45g or 1 eggs Eggs Large Free Range
  • 100g or 4 slice Leg Ham Shaved From The Deli
  • 50g or 0.5 cup Mushrooms loose
  • 5mL or 1 teaspoons Olive Oil
  • 70g or 1 roll Wholemeal Soft Rolls
  • 40g or 1/4 Avo Avocado Shepard
  • 25g or 1 handful Baby Leaf Spinach
  • 15mL or 3 teaspoon Tomato Sauce Reduced Salt & Sugar
